Confucius died in 479 BC. James Legge (1815-1897) translated the Analects, first published in 1861
(Hong Kong, then a British colony, with Trubner, London, United Kingdom).

United States: published before 1931. United Kingdom and Hong Kong (country of origin): every author and
translator died more than 70 years ago.

Standard Ebooks dedicates its own contributions (markup, corrections) to the public domain under
CC0 1.0 (the repository's LICENSE.md).

Sources: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Legge.
